refactor: Phase 4 - Action layer refactoring

Complete Phase 4 refactoring: refactored key actions to use service layer and repositories.

## What Changed

### Actions Refactored
- createRoom(): Now uses roomRepository and playerRepository
- joinRoom(): Now uses roomRepository and playerRepository
- startGame(): Now uses gameService.startGame()

### Services Enhanced
- Added startGame() method to GameService
- Orchestrates player fetching, board generation, and game initialization
- Uses repositories, managers, and generators throughout

### Repositories Enhanced  
- Added isHost parameter to playerRepository.createPlayer()
- Default value: false
- Supports creating host players

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed Board.tsx: Changed tile.number to tile.numberToken
- Fixed imports: ResourceType now from board-data
- Added getCanonicalVertexId import where needed

## Architecture Improvements

Before:
- Actions with direct database queries
- 105+ lines of game initialization in actions.ts

After:
- Actions as thin wrappers (3 lines)
- Service layer orchestrates business logic
- Repository layer handles data access
- Clear separation of concerns

## Benefits
- createRoom reduced by 60%
- startGame reduced from 105 lines to 3 lines (97% reduction in action)
- All game initialization logic properly organized in service layer
- Easy to test each layer independently
- Pattern established for remaining actions
